scripts.test:native: cmake -S . -B build/native -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build/native && ctest --test-dir build/native --output-on-failure
scripts.test:package: cmake --install build/native --prefix build/install && cmake -S tests/package -B build/consumer -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$(pwd)/build/install" && cmake --build build/consumer && build/consumer/libcf-consumer && test -f build/install/share/libcf/runtime.mjs && test -f build/install/share/libcf/emscripten-host.js
scripts.test: npm run test:native && npm run test:package && npm run test:spike && npm run test:core && npm run test:kv
